summary: Frontend-only verification of Knowledge Record Manufacturing Engine™ at /kr-manufacturing. All 8 requested test cases PASSED with zero console errors. Logged in as Founder (Erica Talbert). Sidebar shows nav-kr-manufacturing under KNOWLEDGE section labeled 'Knowledge Record Manufacturing™'. Route /kr-manufacturing renders data-testid kr-manufacturing-page. kr-standard panel renders with 7 numbered principles (principle-0 through principle-6). Stats (kr-mfg-stats): Manufactured/Pending Your Review/In Enterprise Memory™/Confidence Threshold — baseline was 1/0/1/80%. Form (kr-mfg-form) has 3 source options (source-founder_request, source-verified_research, source-library_import); library_import reveals kr-source-text textarea and switching back hides it. Manufacture with source=founder_request, topic='Why saving early matters' produced KR-00078 in ~27s. kr-result panel showed all 6 pipeline stages (stage-0..5): Idea → Research (96% confidence) → Evidence Collection (4 sources) → Knowledge Organization (10/10 sections) → Verification (Advisory) (92%) → Founder Review. Success toast fired: 'KR-00078 drafted — pending your review.'. Pending-list showed the new record with approve-<id>, reject-<id>, a confidence chip, and cited sources. Clicking Approve fired toast 'Approved — entered Enterprise Memory™. Ready to manufacture products.', removed the row from pending, and incremented the 'In Enterprise Memory' stat from 1 → 2. Second record manufactured (topic='How to build a weekly budget'), reject button removed it from pending with toast 'Rejected.'. Final stats: Manufactured 3, Pending 0, Memory 2. All state transitions on stats cards match spec.
critical_code_review_comments: KRManufacturing.js line 156: 'Review sections' button navigates to hard-coded /kr2 route which appears to be a fixed legacy path rather than the specific KR page (e.g. /knowledge/{kr.id}). If /kr2 is intended, ignore; otherwise this should route to the freshly-drafted record. Non-blocking, does not affect the flow described in the spec.

manufacture() (line 42) POSTs the full form object regardless of source_type — for founder_request/verified_research the empty source_text field is still sent. Backend accepts it, but stripping empty optional fields client-side would be cleaner.

The 'Verification (Advisory)' stage reported decision='request_revision' (confidence 92%, above the 80% threshold) yet the record still awaits Founder approval, which is spec-compliant. Worth documenting in the UI that Founder review is required even after advisory clears, so the founder is not confused by 'request_revision' language on a healthy record.
Toast on reject is a plain 'Rejected.' — spec says it should confirm removal from pending; consider 'Rejected — removed from pending review.' for clarity. Cosmetic.
